# Analytics Business Rules

Analytics Business Rules

- Trending products: recent sales significantly higher than baseline.
- Low stock threshold: 20 units.
- Flag spikes for manual review if no promotion explains them.
- Prioritize restocking fast-moving low-stock items.

# Customer Support FAQ

FAQ

- How to place an order: Add items to cart and complete checkout.
- How to track order: Use the Orders page after logging in.
- Payment methods: UPI, Credit/Debit card, Net banking.
- Cancelation: Orders can be canceled before they ship.

# Inventory Rules

Inventory Rules

- Reorder point: when stock <= 20 for fast-moving SKUs.
- Safety stock: keep at least 10% of average weekly demand.
- Bulk orders should be split across multiple suppliers when possible.

# Return Policy

Return Policy

- Most items can be returned within 7 days of delivery if unused and in original packaging.
- Some categories (personal care, gift cards) may be non-returnable.
- Refunds processed after item inspection (5-7 business days).
- Exchanges depend on stock availability; refunds offered when exchange is not possible.

# Shipping Policy

Shipping Policy

- Orders are processed within 1-2 business days.
- Standard delivery: 3-7 business days depending on destination.
- Free standard shipping on eligible orders over the site minimum.
- Customers will receive tracking updates once the package ships.
- Please report damaged shipments within 48 hours of delivery.

# Warranty Rules

Warranty Rules

- Electronics: typically 6-12 months limited warranty.
- Accessories: 3-6 months limited warranty.
- Warranty covers manufacturing defects and hardware failure under normal use.
- Physical damage, water ingress, and unauthorized repairs are excluded.
